description: Who We Are Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them. We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family. The mission Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand. Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets. You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet. Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet. What you'll build Horizon 1: Master the engine (first 90 days) Own the numbers: run the weekly read of the acquisition funnel (spend, leads, qualified sellers, booked calls, expected margin per call) vs plan. Explain every gap down to its root cause and drive the actions that close it. Make the data trustworthy: build the single source of truth with our Data team, set the counting and attribution rules, and own the conversion signals we send to Meta, Google and every new platform, including how we count and value bookings made by our AI sales agent as it takes over the qualification call. Find the first levers: landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly. Horizon 2: Automate the loop (months 3 to 9) Agents that see: automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks. Agents that decide: explicit, testable rules and models for budget allocation, creative cut and scale, bidding signals and activation timing. Agents that act: campaign changes, CRM activations and experiments executed automatically within guardrails, with humans approving what matters. Horizon 3: Scale the autopilot (9 months and beyond) Close the loop between creative, media, CRM and our AI sales agent, so every learning flows back into every channel. Run experimentation on autopilot: hypotheses generated, tests launched, results read and rolled out continuously. Define the operating model of a growth team where agents do the execution and people do the thinking, and grow the team that runs it. Why this role Impact you can measure in euros: every decision you make moves expected margin, and you'll see it within days. Build, don't advise: you'll ship agents, models and automations, not recommendations. You get frontier AI tools, our data platform and engineers who build with you. Direct line to leadership: you'll present growth performance every week and shape decisions at company level. A rare combination: strategy, data, marketing and AI engineering in a single seat.
